Tasks & Calendar

Plan the work next to the writing.

A project board, a roadmap and a calendar — all connected to each other and to the documents they belong to.

Five views of one board

Overview, Board, List, Table and Timeline. Pick the one that fits the moment — the data is the same.

Linked to documents

Attach any document to a card, or create a new one from it. Checklist items inside notes appear on the board automatically.

Quick add

Type “Send report fri 3pm !high @Launch plan” and the date, priority and document are filled in for you.

Subtasks & activity

Break work down, leave comments, and see a clear activity log of every change.

Dates shared with the calendar

Due dates become blocks on your calendar. Drag one there and the task updates.

Progress at a glance

Per-card progress bars and an overview of what’s due, overdue and done.

Ticket keys, epics & links

Tasks are numbered like APP-12, can be a task, bug, story or epic, and can block or relate to each other — a blocked task is flagged.

Sprints

Plan work in time-boxes with a goal, dates, progress and a burndown, then complete the sprint and move what’s left.

Import from Jira

Bring in a Jira CSV export: projects, keys, types, epics, sub-tasks, comments and sprints. Nothing is sent back to Jira.

Timeline

A roadmap you can drag.

See every task as a bar from start to due date, grouped by document or status. Drag a bar to reschedule it or pull an edge to change its length.

  • Group by document or by status
  • Today marker and week scale
  • Changes flow back to the board and calendar
Calendar

Teams-style, without the weight.

Day, work-week, week and month views with drag-to-create, move and resize. A mini month and per-calendar toggles keep things tidy.

  • Overlay tasks and note reminders on your events
  • Sign in with Microsoft 365 to see your Teams meetings (read-only)
  • Or subscribe to Outlook, Google or iCloud with a published link
  • Recurring events, time zones and exceptions handled
  • One-click “Take notes” creates a meeting note for any event
  • Join links for Teams, Zoom and Meet are picked up automatically
How calendar linking works. In your calendar app, publish or copy the calendar’s .ics link, then paste it into Doceo. Subscribed calendars are read-only and refresh about every 30 minutes. Microsoft 365 / Teams sign-in uses the standard Microsoft login in your browser; Doceo only requests permission to read your calendar and stores the token on your computer.

Download Doceo and have your documents, tasks and calendar in one fast desktop app — stored on your own computer.
